title: Tokenized Education
tagline: For completing tasks from clubs and teachers, students are rewarded with tokens. These badges can be applied to a student's profile to highlight their skill set. Professors can find candidates for opportunities as teaching or research assistants by using this database of tokens.
description: This project combines a state channels hub with a web-based front end for universities. Tokens with the ERC-1155 standard are distributed among colleges and student organizations to be rewarded to students via completion and exemplary participation in opportunities in and beyond the classroom. These tokens quantify merit beyond participation. Tokens act as a portfolio outside of one's transcript that can be used to display active involvement on-campus for recruiters to view. Some tokens can also be interchangeable for on-campus store rewards and discounts.
how_its_made:
Triangle is used to create a vault which is used as access to funds from multiple wallets, in order to approve transactions by the admins and owners of the platforms. Tokens in these wallets are controlled by admins that use the wallet as a multi-sig which are then distributed to students. 

Dune Analytics is for administrative tracking of tokens in each college. Visual representation of data will allow administrators within the University to track categories of involvement students are interested in and target them specifically.  

Polygon is used for our deployment.
